snippet.title: Snackrifice - 4 Player Cooperative Dungeon Crawler
snippet.description:
Navigate an ever evolving Purgatory alone or with up to 4 players in this roguelike dungeon crawler. Adapt to perilous curses that plunge each run into chaos. Scavenge for coins to purchase valuable relics to overcome the many faces of Purgatory.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4382960/Snackrifice/
